# What a request may say

Every field a ToneSpec and a Setup may carry. Generated from
[the contract](../pkg/sdk/tone/data/tonespec.openapi.yaml), so it cannot drift
from what the code actually enforces.

These are the two documents a person writes, and neither carries a knob
position. A ToneSpec is the ask and changes every request; a Setup is what
somebody owns and changes when they buy something. What they resolve to is
[a RigSpec](rigspec.md), which nobody writes by hand.

```text
ToneSpec + Setup   what we mean, and what we have
      ↓            tonestack tone build
RigSpec            exact, resolved, deterministic, shareable
      ↓            tonestack presets compile
.hlx               what the pedal eats
```

Every field is optional and any combination is legal. "Punk, but on my Jazz"
is a genre and a Setup; "like Dirnt but chunkier" is a player and a nudge. A
request nobody filled in completely is the ordinary case, and what cannot be
answered is reported rather than guessed at.

A field marked `*` is required. A field that holds another object has
no grammar of its own and shows `—`; the question moves to that
object's table. Every other field is in one of four buckets:

| grammar | means |
| --- | --- |
| closed | one of a fixed set, listed here and refused if it is not one of them |
| looked up | checked against the catalog for the device in hand, so the valid values depend on which device |
| shaped | checked against a pattern |
| open | prose. Nothing parses it, and nothing will refuse it for what it says |

Nothing here is checked against a catalog, because a request names gear the
way a person does and the device it will be built for is a separate question.
That check happens when the rig is compiled.

## ToneSpec

A request for a sound, in whatever terms the person has.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gear` | list of Wanted | — | [Wanted](#wanted) |
| `genre` | string | open | — |
| `like` | Like | — | [Like](#like) |
| `note` | string | open | — |
| `nudges` | list of Nudge | — | [Nudge](#nudge) |
| `schema *` | string | closed | `ToneSpec` |
| `words` | list of string | open | — |

## Device

The hardware, which decides what a chain may cost and what it may hold.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `firmware` | string | open | — |
| `model *` | string | open | — |

## Instrument

One instrument somebody owns, described in what changes the sound.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | boolean | — | `true` or `false` |
| `gear *` | string | open | — |
| `pickups` | string | open | — |
| `strings` | string | closed | `round`, `flat`, `tape`, `unknown` |

## Like

Something to sound like: a player, a band, a song, or a recording handed over.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artist` | string | open | — |
| `band` | string | open | — |
| `recording` | string | open | — |
| `song` | string | open | — |
| `years` | Years | — | [Years](#years) |

## Nudge

A move along one axis from where the chain currently is.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | number | shaped | `0.1` to `5` |
| `word *` | string | open | — |

## Owned

One thing on the device that did not ship with it.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind *` | string | closed | `ir`, `model` |
| `name *` | string | open | — |
| `slot` | integer | shaped | `0` or more |

## Setup

What somebody has.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | Device | — | [Device](#device) |
| `instruments` | list of Instrument | — | [Instrument](#instrument) |
| `owns` | list of Owned | — | [Owned](#owned) |
| `schema *` | string | closed | `Setup` |

## Wanted

A piece of gear the request asks for by name.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gear *` | string | open | — |
| `insist` | boolean | — | `true` or `false` |
| `role` | string | closed | `amp`, `cab`, `drive`, `comp`, `eq`, `mod`, `delay`, `reverb`, `filter`, `pitch`, `wah`, `other` |

## Years

The window a request is about, where a player's sound changed over their career and the request is about one part of it.

| field | holds | grammar | allowed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from *` | integer | shaped | `1900` to `2100` |
| `to *` | integer | shaped | `1900` to `2100` |
